lines.text: Cloudflare redesigned how its D1 database service manages millions of databases.
Live databases grew 15 times in a year. Daily active ones grew 18 times.
lines.title: Growth in one year

lines.text: Each database is its own SQLite copy, and a central Postgres database remembers which ones exist.
lines.title: Two jobs

lines.text: Queries skip the central database and go straight to the database's own copy.
lines.title: A query's path

lines.text: Routing facts live in Workers KV, a store copied around the world, so Postgres stays out of the busy path.
lines.title: Fast lookups

lines.text: Every thirty seconds, each database checks in with Postgres, so mistakes fix themselves.
lines.title: Self-repair

lines.text: Keep busy paths off central spots, expect failures, and let the system repair itself.
lines.title: Takeaways
